removed_lines: Parish Newsletter 15th November 2026 Thirty-third Sunday in Ordinary Time No: 2070 Mt 25:14-30 A New Years Day …. with a difference!
An invitation from the Naas Parish Pastoral Council.
On Friday, 1st January, World Day of Peace, Bishop Denis will celebrate Mass at 11am to mark the beginning of our bicentenary year.
It is a milestone momen t for all of us, thankfully alive to see this special time dawn upon us.
Surely a time of grace and blessing for our parish and its parishioners.

A New Years Day Mass of hope, gratitude and celebration to honour 200 years of faith and community, we invite you to take part in two wonderful ways: Share your memories – please bring along old or recent photographs that evoke cherished memories of our beloved Parish Church – family memories of special days: Baptisms, First Holy Communions/Confirmation Days, your Wedding Day etc.
Please place your name and contact number on the back of the photos so that we can return them to you.

Celebrate our Diversity – we warmly encourage parishioners to wear the traditional dress of their native country, celebrating the rich cultural div ersity that make up our vibrant parish family today.
So, please join us as we give thanks for our past, celebrate our present and look forward to the future together.
Refreshments will be served after Mass. All are welcome!
